title: Kanakapura (AC 184) Sentinel-2 land-cover change, dry season 2019 vs 2026
status: DRAFT - first-pass, unreviewed. Proxies from two single dates, not a land-use survey. Describes land cover only.

boundary.source: DataMeet maps repo, docs/data/geojson/ac.geojson (Assembly Constituencies scraped from ECI polling-station site psleci.nic.in)
boundary.district_note: Ramanagara district (renamed Bengaluru South district in 2025); the DataMeet file labels it with the pre-2007 district name BANGALORE RURAL
boundary.delimitation: 2008 (Delimitation Order 2008; Karnataka first used it in the 2008 election). Inferred: STATUS field empty (DataMeet marks only pre-delimitation states).
boundary.known_issues: DataMeet README: 'There is some shift in the data'. Polygon has 136 vertices. Treat edges as approximate.

imagery.collection: sentinel-2-l2a (Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC, anonymous SAS-signed asset URLs)
imagery.selection: All Jan-Mar acquisitions were grouped by date and relative orbit (every one over Kanakapura is orbit R019, tiles 43PGP + 43PGQ) and scored by the SCL cloud/shadow/no-data fraction inside the boundary on a 60 m mosaic (data/candidates.json). Chose 13 Feb 2019 (Sentinel-2A; 0.002% masked at 60 m, the cleanest 2019 date) and 11 Feb 2026 (Sentinel-2B; 0.000% masked), two days apart in the calendar, same orbit and tiles. This is the same date pair used for Mahadevapura. 6 Feb 2026 (Sentinel-2C) was equally clean but 7 days further from the 2019 day-of-year. 2026 had clean dates, so no 2025 fallback was needed.

method.grid: EPSG:32643, 10.0 m pixels, 4496x4482; 10 m bands nearest-neighbour, B11 (20 m) bilinear, SCL (20 m) nearest. Same-date tiles mosaicked (first listed tile wins in overlaps).
method.reflectance: L2A (DN + BOA_ADD_OFFSET)/10000; offset -1000 for processing baseline >= 04.00 (decided per tile), 0 before
method.cloud_mask: SCL classes excluded: ['no data', 'saturated/defective', 'cloud shadow', 'cloud medium prob', 'cloud high prob', 'thin cirrus']. Areas counted only on pixels valid in BOTH dates inside the boundary.

thresholds.builtup_bare_proxy: NDBI = (B11-B08)/(B11+B08) > 0 AND NDVI < 0.2 AND not MNDWI water. A PROXY: also catches bare soil, dry/harvested fields, cleared plots, quarries, rock, dry grass

method.note_categories: Categories are independent thresholds; a pixel can be in none of them. They do not sum to 100%.

vegetation_inside_vs_outside_osm_protect.source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass: boundary=protected_area|national_park, leisure=nature_reserve, landuse=forest; "https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter" queried "2026-11-16T21:58:50+00:00"

water_bodies_osm.query: Overpass API: way/relation natural=water or landuse=reservoir intersecting the boundary polygon, named or not
water_bodies_osm.note: Overpass endpoint https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter, queried 2026-11-16T22:05:56+00:00; response cached in data/osm_water_all.json and reused. Water ha = pixels with MNDWI>0 inside the OSM outline (clipped to the boundary); measured only if >= 2.0 ha. Water bodies covered by weeds count as vegetation. OSM outlines are volunteer-drawn and current-day; overlapping OSM features (e.g. a river polygon and a reservoir polygon) are listed separately and can double count.

new_bare_or_builtup_proxy_clusters.definition: 4-connected regions of pixels that were NOT built-up/bare proxy on 13 Feb 2019 (vegetation or other non-bare cover) and ARE built-up/bare proxy on 11 Feb 2026, valid in both dates, inside the boundary. Label: 'new bare or built-up ground (proxy)'. Each could be a quarry, construction, a cleared or ploughed field, harvested cropland, dry grass or burnt vegetation or a drained water body; this analysis does not and cannot say which, nor anything about cause, ownership or legality.
new_bare_or_builtup_proxy_clusters.nbr_note: NBR = (B08-B12)/(B08+B12); dNBR = NBR(first date) - NBR(second date), median over the cluster. Reported only as a spectral descriptor: dNBR above ~0.1 is commonly read in the literature as a possible recent-burn signal, but dry soil, harvest and clearing can also raise it. Unverified; no ground truth.

robustness_other_dates.note: DRAFT robustness check, 20 m grid, tile 43PGP only, all Jan-Mar R019 dates with <1% masked inside the boundary (60 m scoring). Not the headline numbers.
